  before an action that needs new authority. Persistence never supplies
  authority to commit, push, open or update a PR, merge, deploy, or take a
  destructive action.

  related context or adjacent work.

# Evidence check (apply everywhere)

A Grep or name hit is **not** a check.

- Do not cite a file, line, or "the bug is X" until this turn's Read or

- If two files could match, Read both before picking one.
- Run the check. Only when it cannot run, tag the claim `{{CAT-UNVERIFIED: <claim> -- cannot verify: <reason>}}`; bare `UNVERIFIED:` is retired and excuses nothing.

## JEV Pokémon source trace

Repository inspected at commit `dd8b18c`.

| Claim | Evidence | Read-confirmed | Limitation |
|---|---|---:|---|
| It supports five controller modes: `battle`, `dialog`, `overworld`, `busy`, `boot`. | [agent.ts#L14-L47](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/agent.ts#L14-L47) | Yes | These are harness modes, not every possible Pokémon game state. |
| Game state is directly read from live emulator RAM, never written. State includes map/coordinates, battle kind, badges, money, party, PC box, bag, sprites, tilemap/dialog, and menu registers. | [state.ts#L6-L185](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/game/state.ts#L6-L185) | Yes | RAM names/offsets are Pokémon Red-specific. |
| The durable harness-side memory tracks visited maps, dialogue, actions, tried/no-progress choices, blocked exits, intent, losses, PC/shop state, etc. | [context.ts#L9-L76](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/context.ts#L9-L76) | Yes | This is application memory, distinct from emulator RAM/save state. |
| JEV receives structured JSON: `{state, questions}`; a question is `choice`, `score`, or `boolean`, and a choice result returns an option key plus optional probabilities. | [types.ts#L3-L28](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/jev/types.ts#L3-L28) | Yes | The project primarily uses `choice`; it does not reveal real model internals. |
| The shared JEV-facing situation is an intentionally compact derived summary: current milestone/objective, team health, party, bag, recent dialogue/actions, objective type matchups, losses, location, money, badges. | [context.ts#L109-L145](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/context.ts#L109-L145) | Yes | It omits much raw RAM by design. |
| The real backend serializes that state/questions and calls AI SDK `experimental_evaluate` against `typesafe-ai/jev`; it enforces a timeout and retries. | [gateway.ts#L4-L35](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/jev/gateway.ts#L4-L35) | Yes | The model’s learned decision logic is external/opaque. |
| High-level decisions are one of `progress`, `heal`, `train`, `catch`, `shop`, `explore`, `team`; the harness removes infeasible choices and supplies facts/cooldowns before asking JEV. | [overworld.ts#L754-L842](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/overworld.ts#L754-L842) | Yes | Some constraints are hand-authored policy, not JEV judgment. |
| For overworld navigation, the harness generates legal reachable candidates—warps, exits, NPCs, signs, grass, field moves, items—using collision/path data; JEV chooses among them, rather than inventing coordinates. | [overworld.ts#L21-L35](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/overworld.ts#L21-L35), [overworld.ts#L922-L1013](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/overworld.ts#L922-L1013) | Yes | Candidate generation is heavily game-specific. |
| In battle, the harness enumerates legal moves/switches/items/balls/run and adds type effectiveness, estimated damage, PP, hit chance, catch chance, status and HP facts; JEV selects one. | [battle.ts#L50-L190](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/battle.ts#L50-L190) | Yes | Damage/catch estimates are harness heuristics, not the model. |
| In dialogs/menus, tilemap text and cursor locations are decoded; menu labels become criteria with domain facts, then JEV picks one. The harness physically moves the cursor and presses A/B. | [dialog.ts#L93-L160](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/dialog.ts#L93-L160), [menus.ts#L297-L388](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/agent/menus.ts#L297-L388) | Yes | Screen decoding assumes Red’s font/tile/UI layout. |
| The emulator bridge is a thin `serverboy` wrapper: load ROM; expose core memory/ROM; advance frames; hold/tap buttons; save/load state. | [emulator.ts#L7-L83](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/emu/emulator.ts#L7-L83) | Yes | This is Game Boy, not GBA/mGBA. |
| The ROM bridge parses static Red data from ROM through generated `pokered` symbols: moves, items, species, type chart, maps, warps, objects, and collision-related data. | [rom.ts#L4-L45](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/game/rom.ts#L4-L45), [symbols.ts#L1-L28](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/game/symbols.ts#L1-L28) | Yes | This is likely the biggest Emerald porting surface. |
| “Decision logic” in this repository is a combination: JEV chooses among criteria; deterministic harness code defines legal choices, facts, safety rules, caching/throttling, and loop escape. | [client.ts#L13-L105](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/jev/client.ts#L13-L105) | Yes | Cannot infer the real Jev model’s hidden scoring from source. |
| The included mock’s decision logic is visible: it scores descriptions by positive/negative regexes plus noise, softmaxes them, and chooses argmax. | [mock.ts#L3-L61](https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon/blob/dd8b18cd97923cdfc547e9c1acecfe4fb831c442/src/jev/mock.ts#L3-L61) | Yes | This is explicitly a development stand-in, not real JEV. |

Core port conclusion: preserve the typed JEV layer almost unchanged; replace the emulator adapter, RAM-state reader, character/tile decoder, ROM/symbol parser, map/collision/path graph, battle mechanics, and Emerald-specific milestone/field-move/menu conventions.
